proposedScopedReference.name: ScopedRevisionRef
proposedScopedReference.definition: Readonly<{ scope: Scope; ref: EntityRef; revision: R | null }>
constraints: Do not redeclare or replace canonical EntityRef/Scope
Null revision is unread/unavailable, never wildcard permission
Extending ENTITY_KINDS is explicit, resolver/tests evolve in same change
Separate origin scope from command destination and attachment read scope
Journal-only source cut uses estate seq; external sources carry immutable own revision alongside it
R is the actual producer revision type, bound per port; preserve numeric config/question/journal revisions without string coercion.

proposedDecisions.choice: Allow setup Project with explicitly unconfigured PM before managed activation; require exactly one admitted PM assignment before managed activation; provider/executor deferred creates no fake runnable binding.
proposedDecisions.caveat: ST001 exactly-one normative claim exceeds observed at-most-one SQL mechanism. ADR0046 is proposed, not implicitly accepted wholesale.

proposedDecisions.choice: Sent messages, accepted checkpoints and business command outcomes extend existing journal and canonical projections; no second event/task/agent store.
Unsent drafts, personal review state and guide progression reuse localState CAS/recovery; not Estate business truth.
Return projection uses journal seq plus independent external source revisions and acknowledgement of exact shown snapshot; preserve existing digest payload boundary behavior.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Atomic journal-backed business command representation
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Current append_event has no generic request ID. Need exact SQL command/event registration/projection ownership and payload identity constraints; do not label existing Journal a ready command producer.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Conversation audience and excerpt access
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Estate membership is not Project-private ACL. Decide authorized message audience/excerpts and revocation behavior before exposing cross-project conversation history.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: PM activation enforcement
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Normative setup-versus-managed decision needs actual activation gate later; current unique index only rejects second active PM. Do not fabricate readiness from docs.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Reference extension for new Message and TaskRun identities
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Canonical EntityRef lacks message/task-run kind. Choose additive kinds with exact resolver or a named typed related identity; no duplicate EntityRef union.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Per-actor persistence on shared desktop and cursor migration
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Current digest marks keyed by Project. Future actor/Estate namespace and legacy migration must not mark unread as seen or infer current user from mutable view.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Schema migration filenames
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Exact numbered SQL paths intentionally unallocated in this prep; reserve migration slot under repository coordination at dispatch to avoid conflict. Native shared/main owner candidates are exact paths; absent files explicitly proposed.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Voice input provider and raw retention
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: No measured STT selection from this source audit. AD13 cannot consume unresolved STT outcome; text journal implementation may proceed independently.

irreducibleAmbiguities.subject: Checkpoint persistence grain
irreducibleAmbiguities.detail: Only accepted useful checkpoint/next step is business event. Passive cursor/visited UI state remains personal. Do not append every navigation or claim unselected source coverage.
